description: ga_vichara writer (chart_vichara, per ayanamsha). (1) constituent_fact_ids / constituent_facts_array are written as a SORTED list (was the unsorted iteration order of a Python set, which varies with PYTHONHASHSEED): an ORDER-ONLY change on every surviving row whose stored order differs from sorted order (reader-measured on the stored canonical generation: 4,773 of 7,774 surviving rows: krishnamurti 980, lahiri_chitrapaksha 968, raman 1000, surya_siddhanta_classical 892, true_chitra 933); membership, values and every other column unchanged. This also stabilises the migration-920 output digest (its key and value columns include constituent_fact_ids as an ordered array). (2) Rows exactly equal on every stored column (cf compared sorted, value_jsonb canonical) are removed, first occurrence kept: 150 per ayanamsha, all valence_pass link_kind lord_placed of MAR, MER, JUP, VEN, SAT (30 each); the survivor already lists every collapsed link in its constituent_fact_ids (no provenance lost). valence_pass 1,650 -> 1,500 per ayanamsha (7,500 canonical, 750 rows removed); chart_vichara canonical total 8,524 -> 7,774 (1,556 x 3 + 1,553 x 2). (3) The writer asserts no two rows share (chart_id, ayanamsha_id, vichara_family, subject, target, domain, varga_id, formula_version, constituent_fact_ids sorted) and fails with a named-identity error, not at capture. (4) rows_inserted reported == rows inserted. (5) leverage_index is TIME-INDEXED by design: its dasha-runway term is relative to an as-of that is now the UTC DATE of the build run's creation (build_runs.created_at, read via ctx.db_conn), recorded on every leverage row as value_jsonb.as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) and value_jsonb.as_of_source = 'build_run_created_at' (ctx.config['as_of'] override => 'config_override'; there is no wall-clock fallback on the orchestrator path: a run without a resolvable creation date raises). 175 canonical leverage_index rows gain these two keys. leverage_index value_num and value_jsonb.dasha_runway_weight / years_to_start / md_duration_years change with the as-of: compare ONLY at equal as-of; a rebuild on a different day legitimately differs. The migration-920 leverage component, the flip report and delta-skip therefore move between rebuilds on different days: expected, not a defect. (6) ratification rows are inserted in sorted-subject order instead of Python set order (bigserial id order only). The L1 data-plane capture owner-side trigger (constituent_fact_ids added to its arguments) is another lane (d6-combined).
